summary: Build kingdom in turn-based strategy games & conquer epic hex civilization map
description:
Do you have what it takes to build an epic empire? ⚔️ Welcome to Hexapolis: Civilization Wars, a unique 4X turn-based strategy game where you must build a mighty medieval kingdom, lead epic battles, and conquer the hex map! Grow from a small village into a sprawling, powerful city and prepare your civilization for the ultimate survival challenge.

In Hexapolis, the age of empires is reborn. Raise your swords, gather resources, and defend your lands against fierce outlanders. It's a tactical battle for total control! 🛡️

🌟 4X STRATEGY: EXPLORE, EXPAND, EXPLOIT, EXTERMINATE
Every turn is a new opportunity. Explore uncharted hexes, gather essential resources, and conquer rival strongholds. Unleash the art of war as you command mighty heroes, including archers, fierce dragons, brave crusaders, and skilled sailors. Each unit boasts unique abilities to help you dominate the battlefield!

🏰 BUILD YOUR DREAM KINGDOM
Grow your civilization from a humble settlement to a glorious empire. Construct farms, mines, and military barracks. Master deep tech trees to unlock ancient technologies, enhance your economy, and prepare your armies for epic multiplayer and single-player campaign missions.

🗺️ MAP EDITOR & CUSTOM CAMPAIGNS
Want to create your own world? Use the intuitive Map Editor to generate custom scenarios, design unique battlefields, and share your creations with a global community of players. Choose your own path to victory!

✨ GAME FEATURES:
• Turn-Based Tactical Gameplay: Deep, engaging strategy mechanics.
• Epic Heroes & Factions: Train unique units with special abilities.
• Master Ancient Tech: Research economy, military, and defense upgrades.
• Two Game Modes: Play on Normal for a fun, relaxed experience or Hard for a brutal survival challenge.
• Stunning Low-Poly Graphics: Enjoy clean, stylized, and beautiful 3D visuals.
• Custom Map Generator: Create, play, and share custom maps with friends!

Are you ready to lead humankind to global victory? The civilization wars have begun. Play now, choose your strategy, and build the ultimate hex empire! 🏆

FAQ & SUPPORT
❓ Can I play offline? Yes! Hexapolis features robust single-player modes you can enjoy anywhere.
❓ How do I use the map editor? Unlock the map editor in the main menu to easily create and share custom hex boards!
